verdict.rationale: MX supports background/autonomous processes such as automatic re-aggregation of accounts roughly every 24 hours and webhook-driven event notifications that let integrators build automated workflows, and it exposes an MCP server that could let AI agents invoke MX capabilities. However, there is no evidence of an AI-native automation builder, scheduling/orchestration UI, or explicit support for agents autonomously configuring and running multi-step automations. missing for 10: AI-native automation configuration UI/API, evidence of agent-triggered multi-step workflows, orchestration/scheduling beyond fixed 24h aggregation.
